description: Can add a credential (secret/certificate) to an application or service principal, then log in as it.

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'Add service principal credentials' (directory logging is default-on).
Unusual addition of credentials to an OAuth app (built-in detection).
Subsequent service-principal sign-in with the new credential appears in SP sign-in logs.

prerequisite_privilege: Owner of, or a directory role over, the target app/SP
abuse_primitive: az ad app credential reset / Add-AzureADApplicationPasswordCredential, then auth as the SP.
notes: The canonical Entra service-principal persistence/escalation edge.
